P. now this species is classified as least concern

• Sentence **R** will be first sentence of the sequence because it is the correct extension of the fixed sentence i.e. **"American alligators were once threatened by extinction but". **
 
• Sentence **S** will come after **R** because it mentions that it was then placed in the endangered species list.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate adverb to fill in the blank.**

Nitha can assemble the students of her class _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is:** quickly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct **adverb **to be used here is **quickly**.
 
• **Quickly **is an adverb of manner.
 
• **Adverbs of manner** are used in sentences to give the listener or reader additional information about the action being performed by the sentence's subject.
 
• It is usually identified by asking the question **'how'.**
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• **​**We are waiting **eagerly **for our chance.
 
 
 
• The sentence describes Nitha's ability to assemble the students of her class, and using the adverb "**quickly**" suggests that she can do so in a fast or efficient manner.
 
 
• Example sentence: Nitha can assemble the students of her class **quickly **in case of an emergency drill.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.​**

 

**Therefore, the correct sentence will be:** *Nitha can assemble the students of her class **quickly__.***

*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__***

 
• **Option 1 ("perfect") **is an adjective and cannot be used to modify the verb "assemble" in the sentence.
 
• **Option 2 ("distract")** is also incorrect because it would suggest that Nitha is able to assemble the students in a way that distracts them, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 ("slow") **is the opposite of what is suggested by the context of the sentence, which implies that Nitha is able to assemble the students quickly.

questions.question:
**Fill in the blank with the correct collocation.**

Of course, we agree with that measure, it is _________ sensible.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is:** perfectly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct collocation to be used here is **perfectly**.
 
• **Collocation **is two or more words that often go together.
 
• The collocation to be used here is: **adverb + adjective.**
 
• Example: 
 
 
• Are you **fully aware** of the consequences of leaving the company now? 
 
 
 
• The phrase **"perfectly sensible" **means **completely reasonable, logical, or rational.**
 
 
• Example sentence: The decision to extend the deadline for the project was **perfectly sensible** given the unforeseen circumstances.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

**Correct Sentence:**__* Of course, we agree with that measure, it is **__perfectly__** sensible.***​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• Other **types of collocations **are:

 
• adjective + noun (excruciating pain)
 
• noun + noun (round of applause)
 
• noun + verb (bomb went off)
 
• verb + noun (commit suicide)
 
• verb + expression with preposition (burst into tears)
 
• verb + adverb (wave frantically)

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Sanjay rolled the marble through a small plastic pipe.

options.text: A small plastic pipe was rolled through a marble by Sanjay.
The marble was rolled through a small plastic pipe by Sanjay.
The marble was rolled by Sanjay in a small plastic pipe.
The marble through a small plastic pipe was rolled by Sanjay.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The marble was rolled through a small plastic pipe by Sanjay.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Active Voice**, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In **Passive Voice**, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence. T
 
• The given sentence is in the **active voice** and it is in **the past simple tense**.
 
• When we convert this sentence into a **passive voice**, the **subject ''Sanjay'' **of the active voice **becomes the object**, the **object ''** **the marble****'' **becomes the **subject.**
 
• The active format **"V2 (rolled)" **should be converted into the passive format **"was + V2 (rolled)"**.
 
• This is the **active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'**.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *The marble was rolled through a small plastic pipe by Sanjay.*
